posts.post_caption:
What the model is doing while you read a preview.

Last five results, weighted — the most recent game counts about twice what the fifth one does. The late team sheet, because an out an hour before kickoff moves the number more than anything published on Tuesday. Rest days and kilometres travelled.

Then the weighting itself. Not just the pick — which input actually moved it.

Timestamped before kickoff. Graded after.
